camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeAddressBook --region cn-hangzhou --AssetMemberUids '[135806271]' --PageSize 10 --Query '192.0.XX.XX' --GroupType ip --GroupUuid 'f04ac7ce-628b-4cb7-be61-310222b70000' --CurrentPage 1 --ContainPort 80 --Lang zh
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-address-book --lang zh --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --query 192.0.XX.XX --group-type ip --contain-port 80 --group-uuid f04ac7ce-628b-4cb7-be61-310222b70000 --asset-member-uids 135806271 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAddressBook

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the address book description. Valid values:
en: English.
zh: Chinese (default)
parameters.help_zh: 地址簿描述的语言类型
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The page number in a paged query.

Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page of data is returned
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。

默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of address books on each page in a paged query.

Default value: 10, which indicates that each page contains 10 results. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置每页包含的地址簿的数量。

默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果。最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The search condition. Enter the address book information that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 搜索条件，输入待查询地址簿信息
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en:
The type of the address book.

If you do not set this parameter, IP address books and ECS tag-based address books are queried
parameters.help_zh:
地址簿的类型。

不设置该参数表示查询IP地址簿和ECS标签地址簿
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en: Queries address books that contain the specified port. This parameter takes effect only when the GroupType parameter is set to port
parameters.help_zh: 查询包含指定端口的地址簿。仅当GroupType参数的值为port时，该参数才会作为本次查询的条件
parameters.name: contain_port

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the address book
parameters.name: group_uuid

parameters.help_en: The list of member accounts for the asset address book
parameters.help_zh: 资产地址簿，成员账号列表
parameters.name: asset_member_uids
